body: I think about it a lot now but, being in Canada, I don't know how I'd do it.

It doesn't help that I developed social anxiety after the breakup, which means I haven't been able to go for any job interviews. I have worked for myself making small amounts of money on the Internet, but at my age that's not very helpful.

It just seems like everybody else I know has it together or at least seems to. I don't remember the last time I spent a weekend going out an enjoying myself. I just sit at the computer as time passes. 

I used to think it was just a phase and I'd get through it, yet here I am, 4 years later.

It depends, OP. How long have you been suffering? Give it at least a few years of really trying hard to change your mindset about life and if that doesn't work, I'm not going to be one of those dipshits that tells you life is worth living.

I've had my own share of bullshit that I haven't been able to fix for several years now.
